does: Copies a whole array of roll streams into another: clears the target, then copies each stream into it.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's stream count (+0x14): every frame 1->0 at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105D919 and 0->1 at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105D967 from SystemUpdate<UpdateSystem> (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x238ABC3); its only callee per stream is CopyStream (code:eoc::roll::stream::CopyStream); SaveStreams calls it with the manager's streams
A write watch on the roll manager's stream count goes to 0 at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105D919 and back at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105D967 every frame

A count-only probe on it shows its calls coming from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x238ABC3, the update of the roll streams every frame, and once after a roll from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x342DDF9, the save of the streams
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
